Conclusion Whether the Cockroach Janta Party represents a genuine expression of youth frustration, a carefully crafted political campaign, or a combination of both, it has already become a significant talking point in India’s political discourse.

Dipke, who has previously worked with political campaigns associated with the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), positioned the movement as a voice for frustrated youth and citizens disillusioned with the political establishment.

The movement’s rapid digital growth drew attention from political observers, supporters, and critics alike, with many questioning whether the campaign reflected a genuine grassroots uprising or a highly organised political communication strategy.
